map.根据帧数、单帧渲染时间、并行节点和重试率估算总渲染时长，支持按日工作时长输出排期: Estimate total render duration from frame count, per-frame render time, parallel nodes and retry rate, with schedule suggestions by daily working hours.
map.总渲染小时 = 帧数 × (1 + 重试率) × 单帧时间(分钟) / 60；实: Total render hours = frames × (1 + retry rate) × per-frame time (minutes) / 60; actual time = total render hours / node count
map.总渲染小时 = 帧数 × (1 + 重试率) × 单帧时间（分钟） / 60，节: Total render hours = frames × (1 + retry rate) × per-frame time (minutes) / 60; node parallelism spreads the above total duration by node count. The retry rate reflects the re-run cost caused by failed re-renders; a baseline value is given from historical projects first.

map.评估加节点或提高单帧效率的收益：对比不同配置下的工期差异。: Evaluate the gain of adding nodes or raising per-frame efficiency: compare schedule differences under different configurations.
map.总帧数 3 000、单帧 4 分钟、节点 5 台、帧率 24 fps、每日工作: Total frames 3000, per-frame 4 min, 5 nodes, frame rate 24 fps, 12 working hours/day, failure retry rate 10%: effective frames = 3000 × 1.10 = 3300 frames; total render time = 3300 × 4 = 13200 min = 220 hours; wall-clock time = 220 ÷ 5 = 44 hours; schedule = 220 ÷ 12 ≈ 18.3 days; finished length = 3000 ÷ 24 = 125 s (≈ 2.1 min). If nodes are increased to 10, wall-clock drops to 22 hours, but total machine-hours and cost stay the same—only faster delivery.
map.重试率按多少填？: What retry rate should I enter?
map.按历史项目的失败帧比例填，常见 5–15%。复杂场景（大量毛发、体积光、置换）容: Enter by the failed-frame ratio of historical projects, commonly 5–15%. Complex scenes (heavy hair/fur, volumetric light, displacement) fail easily, use a higher value; simple scenes use a lower value.
map.为什么加节点墙钟时间减半但工期天数不是减半？: Why does adding nodes halve wall-clock time but not the schedule days?
map.工期按总机时 ÷ 每日工作小时计算，与节点数无关；墙钟时间才是总机时 ÷ 节点数: Schedule is computed by total machine-hours ÷ daily working hours, independent of node count; wall-clock time is total machine-hours ÷ node count. Adding nodes shortens waiting time, not total workload.
